name: std::move_sentinel<S>::move_sentinel
intro:
Constructs a new sentinel adaptor.

1) Default constructor. The underlying sentinel is value-initialized.

2) The underlying sentinel is initialized with x.

3) The underlying sentinel is initialized with that of other.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x

 -

 sentinel to adapt


 other

 -

 sentinel adaptor to copy

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::bidirectional_iterator
recommendedExamples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies bidirectional_iterator.
